name: Rosa Quintero
bio: Rosa opened Flash in 2016 after ten years in other people's shops. She draws flowers the way botanists do, then makes them sit right on the body.
alt: Rosa, a tattoo artist with dark curly hair, tattooing a client's arm in red gloves

name: Dario Mendes
bio: Bold lines, a small palette, and designs that still read from across the room in twenty years. Dario draws most of the flash on the wall.
alt: Dario, a tattooed artist in a white T-shirt, standing with his arms crossed

name: Wren Hallow
bio: Wren does the delicate work, from single-needle script to careful cover-ups. The artist to see for a first tattoo.
alt: Wren, a tattoo artist with long hair, working on a client's wrist at a padded arm rest
